classification.difficultyReason: Identify the height–radius right triangle, halve a base side or diameter where needed, and apply the explicitly requested Pythagoras calculation.

content.prompt:
You are given the perpendicular height (or altitude).
Calculate the slant height using Pythagoras’ Theorem. Answer in exact surd form if necessary.

spec.description: Square-based upright pyramid with explicit front and right visible faces, dashed rear edges and altitude, dotted face slant height x, and right-angle marks. The supplied blue half-base calculation remains editable below the figure.
spec.mathematics: Perpendicular height 35 cm; square-base side 24 cm; face slant height x meets the midpoint of a base side.

spec.description: Upright square-based pyramid with explicit visible faces, dashed hidden edges and internal construction lines, face-height right-angle mark, and external perpendicular-height dimension on the right.
spec.mathematics: Square-base side 20 cm; perpendicular height 24 cm; required face slant height.
spec.answerVisibility: Only source givens and construction lines are visible.

answer.worked:
Half the base side is $20\div2=10\text{ cm}$.
$\begin{aligned}l^2&=24^2+10^2\\l^2&=676\\l&=26\text{ cm}\end{aligned}$

spec.description: Upright square-based pyramid with explicit visible faces, dashed hidden and altitude lines, dotted face-height construction and right-angle marks.

answer.worked:
Half the base side is $1.6\div2=0.8\text{ m}$.
$\begin{aligned}l^2&=1.5^2+0.8^2\\l^2&=2.89\\l&=1.7\text{ m}\end{aligned}$
